verdict.rationale: Marqeta is an API-first platform: its open Core API and sandbox simulation endpoints let programs create cards and simulate authorizations and reversals without a UI, which supports headless automation and automated testing. Nothing documents CI usage specifically. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance, a CLI or SDK for scripted runs, non-interactive credential/test-environment setup for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use open APIs to create new payment products or streamline supplier and workforce payments.
The sandbox environments provide a set of endpoints that let you simulate various types of card network transactions, such as authorizations, reversals, and balance inquiries.
The Marqeta platform provides a sandbox environment where you can explore the capabilities of the Core API.
